author: The Current
description:
Singer-songwriter and musician Liz Phair spoke with The Current’s Morning Show about using the full range of emotions for creating art.

Liz Phair will be performing at Palace Theater on Wednesday, September 16 with Sleater-Kinney.

Listen to The Current’s Morning Show with Jill Riley and Nilufer Arsala weekdays 5 to 10 am.
